title: [CQ-M06b] Six-workstream composition fixtures
description:
Objective: Prove that the six CQ workstreams compose: no stale-revision, check, recipe or isolation bypass at the seams between contract (F), context (C), delivery (V), isolation (R), client (I) and rollout (M). This is a SPIDR slice of [CQ-M06] (task-ced857485a1c4d75b57cc25dcc9b4d82), which keeps the docs sweep, the full regression and the whole-epic review. It depends on CQ-M05, which waits on every workstream's final task (F12, C11, V12, R13, I06), so all producers have landed when it runs.

Deliverable: packages/moe-daemon/src/__e2e__/workstreamComposition.e2e.test.ts. It is tests only, using real tools and stores and temp Git repos, with one describe per seam:
- Stale revision (F×C×V): a requirement edit after approval advances planRevision. Plan reuse then never resumes the row, the recipe instance reads stale, and strict entry or completion is refused PLAN_REVISION_NOT_APPROVED. A review, candidate or check run bound to the old revision is refused, or does not satisfy delivery.
- Check (V×C×M): under a strict deliveryPolicy, each of these is refused at delivery, identically under legacy and observe: a missing, failing or inconclusive required check; a caller-labelled runner observation; a candidate that edits a protected check config or the recipe definitions.
- Recipe (C×F×M): an ineligible or mismatched instantiation falls back to ordinary planning with no approval stamp, and 'moe-recipe' impersonation is refused.
- Isolation (R×M×V×I): verified-local is refused on every path (settings activation through the CQ-M05 control, claim, completion, delivery) with no host fallback. Nothing records isolation, readiness or verifiedLocal from a legacy or observe runner, check or client.
Every refusal asserts the exact codeName and that nothing was written. Legacy control rows keep their compatibility outcomes.

Not in scope:
- New production behavior. A defect fix over about 30 lines, or any contract change, goes to its owning task through moe.report_blocked.
- IDE rendering (I06), real VM provisioning (R13) and docs.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test
definitionOfDone: workstreamComposition.e2e.test.ts covers the stale-revision, check, recipe and isolation seams named in the description, each through real tools with exact codeName assertions.
Every refusal case also proves nothing was written: task, attempt, candidate, check, review and receipt bytes are unchanged.
No gate is mocked, no test-only certification is used, and verified-local is never made ready.
Legacy-profile control rows keep their existing compatibility outcomes in the same scenarios.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits 0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

Cases: - D1a, settings (M×I). Table over ['legacy','observe'], each set through h.state.updateSettings. Then updateSettings({executionProfile:'verified-local'}) must be refused, with project.json bytes unchanged. Exactly one new PROJECT_SETTINGS_UPDATED record appears, equal to {setting:'executionProfile', from:

, to:'verified-local', transition:'activate', outcome:'refused', codeName:'EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY', unsupportedCapabilities:[vm, client, check with M05's landed reasons]}. Use the landed key names, but keep the assertion exact. - D1b, claim (R×M). Settings are legacy. Seed a WORKING unassigned row S with a stored verified-local snapshot, and a legacy control row L. - An explicit claim_next_task {taskId:S, ...RUNNER} by seat W is refused, and h.state.getWorker(W) stays undefined (no registration). - An implicit WORKING claim by W returns L, never S. - S's record stays byte-unchanged, and get_context S still reports effectiveProfile 'verified-local'. - D1c, completion after an audited rollback (M×V, CQ-M05's attempt-level readiness). Use M05's S2 row-a seed: settings executionProfile 'verified-local' (the hand edit), a WORKING row T held by W with every step done, and W's open attempt whose OWN snapshot is verified-local and carries eligible step evidence plus a served-context session. - updateSettings({executionProfile:'legacy'}) applies, and its rollback record carries retainedStrictAttempts 1 and that attempt's id. - complete_task with the attempt's identity is refused; T stays WORKING, and the attempt keeps its verified-local snapshot. - Legacy control: the same seed with a legacy attempt snapshot completes to REVIEW (F12's compatibility outcome). - D1d, delivery (V×M×F). Use reviewBinding.test.ts's toReview(): real tools under legacy, QA attempt gen2, context read. - Apply strict() (the in-memory flip). qa_approve with QA's full identity and the current candidate gets past V06's binding and is refused NOT_READY; no review is written. - updateSettings({executionProfile:'legacy'}) records the rollback with retainedStrictTasks 0 and retainedStrictAttempts 0, since strictness was live-only. - The same approval then reaches DONE: the compatibility outcome. After D1, every stored strict record (S, T's attempt) still carries profile 'verified-local'. Error handling in the fixtures: a failed seed or setup throws a named error, and refused() checks the codeName first, so no case passes vacuously. Run the file in the step-3 Linux snapshot.
